description: Load uploaded node and distance-link files, launch the network, switch to Gantt Chart, and create a date-range entry from the symptom-window fields.
primary_assertions: 30 rendered Gantt bars; 30 y-axis rows; settings table shows the selected start and end fields; backing Gantt timelines cover the loaded nodes with complete symptom dates.
notes: This is the maintained uploaded node + link Gantt smoke baseline after sparse symptom rows are filtered instead of being backfilled into artificial ranges.

description: Load an uploaded sequence node list, launch the network, switch to Gantt Chart, and create a date-range entry from `ipstart` to `ipend`.
primary_assertions: 14 rendered Gantt bars; at least one bar width is greater than the single-date fallback; settings table shows `ipstart` and `ipend` for the maintained entry.
notes: This is the best maintained sequence-node path because the fixture already carries both range and single-date fields.

description: Load an uploaded sequence node list, switch to Gantt Chart, and create a single-date entry from `Diagnosis date` with no separate end field.
primary_assertions: 14 rendered Gantt bars; every bar uses the 15px fixed-width fallback; settings table shows `Diagnosis date` as both start and end after auto-fill.
notes: Covered in the maintained sequence-node Gantt flow as the stable single-date file-type path; the more targeted multi-entry lifecycle now lives in its own journey.

description: Create an uploaded-data Gantt entry, export the view as SVG, and verify the saved artifact is non-empty and contains the rendered entry label.
primary_assertions: Downloaded SVG contains `<svg`; the artifact is non-empty; the exported text contains `Symptom Window`; the export dialog auto-closes after save.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data Gantt export journey after the export pane was wired to close automatically on successful save.

description: Create a second Gantt entry on uploaded data, reopen Gantt Settings, and verify stacked entries can be reviewed and removed while the remaining entry stays intact.
primary_assertions: Both entries remain visible in the settings table and legend; removing one entry leaves the other intact; the rendered SVG bar count drops back to one entry per node for the surviving entry.
notes: Covered in the maintained multi-entry journey after Gantt's empty-state initialization stopped tripping the runtime-error banner on later settings reopens.

description: Set File Settings → View to Launch = `Gantt Chart`, launch uploaded data, and land directly in the Gantt view.
primary_assertions: `Gantt Chart` is selectable in File Settings; launch completes into Gantt without requiring a post-launch view switch; the direct-launch view remains interactive enough to create a maintained entry on both uploaded file types.
notes: Covered in the maintained direct-launch Gantt smoke for uploaded node+link and sequence-node paths.

description: Create one uploaded Gantt entry, change its color from the settings table, and verify the rendered bars and legend swatch update.
primary_assertions: Rendered `.gantt-entry` fill changes to the selected color; the legend swatch uses the same color; `ganttEntries[0].color` and `ganttChartData[0].color` stay in sync.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the settings-table row color was re-synchronized with the rendered chart state.

description: Create one uploaded Gantt entry, change its opacity from the settings-table transparency control, and verify the rendered bars and legend swatch update.
primary_assertions: Rendered `.gantt-entry` opacity changes; legend swatch opacity changes; `ganttEntries[0].opacity` and `ganttChartData[0].opacity` stay in sync.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

description: Toggle Visual Settings → Grid between Show and Hide on uploaded data.
primary_assertions: The chart background rect fill switches between the grid pattern URL and `none`; bars remain rendered; no Gantt entry state is lost.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

description: Change Visual Settings → Spacing (Y) and verify the rendered row positions and chart height update.
primary_assertions: `ganttChartElement.gridWidthY` updates; `.y-axis-text` y-positions move; bar heights or vertical spacing change while row count stays constant.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

description: Change Visual Settings → Spacing (X) and verify the rendered horizontal scale and SVG width update.
primary_assertions: `ganttChartElement.gridWidthX` updates; SVG width grows or shrinks; date-axis positions shift while entry count stays constant.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

description: Change Visual Settings → Font Size and verify the rendered axis labels re-render at the new size.
primary_assertions: Rendered x-axis and y-axis text font sizes change; SVG width updates to accommodate the larger labels; existing entries remain visible.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

description: Create an uploaded-data Gantt entry, export the view as PNG, and verify the saved artifact is non-empty.
primary_assertions: Downloaded file has a PNG signature and non-zero size; the requested filename is used; the export dialog auto-closes after save.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data Gantt export flow alongside the SVG and JPEG paths.

description: Create an uploaded-data Gantt entry, export the view as JPEG, and verify the saved artifact is non-empty.
primary_assertions: Downloaded file has a JPEG signature and non-zero size; the requested filename is used; the export dialog auto-closes after save.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data Gantt export flow alongside the SVG and PNG paths.

subarea: Sparse date fields skip incomplete rows
description: Create a Gantt entry from fields where some nodes have a start date, an end date, or both missing, and verify only complete rows render bars.
primary_assertions: Rendered bar count matches only the nodes with both dates populated; no invalid-width bars appear; settings entry still creates without crashing.
notes: Covered with the synthetic uploaded node+link edge-case fixture after Gantt entry creation was switched to the preserved raw date values instead of the globally backfilled date strings.

description: Create a Gantt entry from fields containing `GMT±####` timestamps and verify bars render on the expected calendar dates.
primary_assertions: Bars render instead of collapsing; the normalized dates align with the intended day boundaries; exported SVG labels remain sane after normalization.
notes: Covered with the synthetic uploaded node+link edge-case fixture so the timezone-stripping branch in `makeGanttEntry()` is exercised deterministically.

description: Create a new Gantt entry with an empty name and verify the component assigns `Entry 1` style defaults.
primary_assertions: The settings table shows `Entry 1`; the legend label uses the generated name; subsequent unnamed entries increment deterministically.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

subarea: Switch away and back preserves created entries
description: Create one or more Gantt entries, switch to another view, then return to Gantt and verify the entries and visual settings remain applied.
primary_assertions: Entry rows remain in the settings table; rendered bar count and colors persist; Grid, Spacing, and Font settings remain in effect after re-entry.
notes: Covered in the maintained controls journey after the empty-state runtime banner regression was fixed in product code.

subarea: Export dialog filetype toggle and cancel path
description: Toggle the Gantt export dialog between PNG, JPEG, and SVG, then cancel without exporting.
primary_assertions: The selected file type changes as expected; cancel closes the dialog cleanly; reopening the dialog starts from a sane state and does not retain a broken filename or filetype combination.
notes: Covered in the maintained uploaded-data export journey alongside the real SVG/PNG/JPEG writes.

description: Land in Gantt before any entry exists, close and reopen `Gantt Settings`, and verify the empty-state view stays interactive without surfacing the runtime-error banner.
primary_assertions: No runtime-error banner appears on the empty state; `Gantt Settings` can be reopened before the first entry is created; the first real entry can still be created immediately afterward.
notes: Covered in the maintained empty-state Gantt journey on both uploaded node+link and sequence-node fixtures.

subarea: Removing the final entry returns to a clean empty state
description: Create one uploaded Gantt entry, remove the final remaining row, and verify the chart returns to a clean empty state that still allows a new entry to be created.
primary_assertions: All rendered bars and legend swatches disappear after the last-row removal; the settings table clears; `Gantt Settings` remains usable and a replacement entry can be created without reload.
notes: Covered in the maintained multi-entry journey by removing the only entry
column16: and creating a replacement single-date entry.

subarea: New-entry validation blocks empty date selection
description: Attempt to click `Create Entry` while the start and end date fields are still `None` and verify the UI prevents an invalid empty entry.
primary_assertions: No blank settings-table row is created; no invisible empty chart entry is added; the dialog either stays open with validation feedback or otherwise blocks submission until a valid date field is selected.
notes: Covered in the maintained empty-state Gantt journey after `Create Entry` was hardened to require a start field before submission.
